lines.t: Born into the static of a broken world
Lines of lies in the code of a boy and girl
Neon towers preaching in a dead tongue
Harlot lullabies sung to the young
I feel the script in my veins like a cage
Heartbeat synced to the system’s rage
I feel the script in my veins like a cage
Heartbeat synced to the system’s rage
Whispers in the dark say, “You’re not free”
But a Voice in the silence is calling me
Break… the… code
Tear… the… script
Heart awakes, every chain must slip
In the midnight noise, I hear His call
YahuShua cracks the code in my fractured soul
Wires in my mind from the beast and the screen
Family ghosts, church scars, all in the machine
False light flickers in cathedral glass
But the heart sees truth when the idols pass
I feel a tremor in the lines they wrote
Fire on the edges of the lies I quote
Every hidden wound pulling me down
Then His Name hits the dark like a thunder sound
Code… unlocked
Script… undone
Heart of stone meets the Holy One
From the ashes of the world I knew
Light explodes as He makes me new[POST-DROP SPOKEN]
“It is the heart that sees…
When His heart beats in me…
I am not my history…
I am who He wrote me to be…”
But He rewrites me deep where no scanner goes
Galaxies spin in a single word
When He speaks, every counterfeit line is burned
Feel the voltage of His love in my chest
Signal from Heaven in a system stressed
Every synapse sings, “Let the old self die”
As new code streams from a higher Sky
Break… break… break the code
Glory light overload
Script… script… script undone
Bass rolls in like a rising sun
Out of the system, out of the night
YahuShua writes me in living light
No more puppets to the empire’s lie
No more eyes blind under digital sky
Even if I walk where my eyes can’t see
With His heart inside, that’s vision in me
Heartbeat, kick drum, pulse in sync
At the edge of the void, one step, one blink
When I fall through the floor of the life I knew
Arms like fire catch me, pull me through
When the code is cracked, when the chains all fall
When the script is shattered on the system wall
There’s a shockwave roaring through my core
YahuShua writes a line that was never there beforeBreak… the… code (hey!)
Tear… the… script (hey!)
Every lie erased in a blinding shift
From the womb to the stars, every wounded part
Overwritten now by His burning heart
In the ruins of the program, I finally see
It’s with the heart, not the eyes, that He set me free
Dystopian night behind, New Day breaking through
In the bass, in the light, I’m alive in You… YahuShua
